/-- [nora_kernel::tokens::verify_token]:
    Source: 'src/tokens.rs', lines 117:0-167:1
    Visibility: public -/
def tokens.verify_token
  (store : tokens.TokenStore) (crypto : oracle.Crypto) (token : Slice Std.U8)
  (now : Std.U64) (mono : Std.U64) :
  Result ((alloc.vec.Vec tokens.TokenWrite) × (core.result.Result
    ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × Role) tokens.TokenError))
  := do
  let b ← tokens.starts_with token tokens.TOKEN_PREFIX
  if b
  then
    let cache_key ← oracle.Crypto.sha256_hex crypto token
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.cache
    let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
    let o ← tokens.find_cached s s1
    match o with
    | none =>
      let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.files
      let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
      let v ← tokens.prefix16 s3
      let s4 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref v
      let o1 ← tokens.find_file s2 s4
      match o1 with
      | none =>
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, core.result.Result.Err
          tokens.TokenError.NotFound)
      | some f =>
        let tf ←
          alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
            tokens.TokenFile) store.files f
        match tf.info with
        | none =>
          ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, core.result.Result.Err
            tokens.TokenError.Storage)
        | some i =>
          let info ← tokens.TokenInfo.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone i
          let s5 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref info.token_hash
          let s6 ←
            lift (Array.to_slice
              (Array.make 7#usize [
                36#u8, 97#u8, 114#u8, 103#u8, 111#u8, 110#u8, 50#u8
                ]))
          let b1 ← tokens.starts_with s5 s6
          let (writes, hash_valid) ←
            if b1
            then
              do
              let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref info.token_hash
              let hash_valid1 ← oracle.Crypto.argon2_verify crypto token s7
              ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, hash_valid1)
            else
              do
              let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref info.token_hash
              let s8 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
              let b2 ← oracle.bytes_eq s7 s8
              let v1 ←
                if b2
                then
                  do
                  let s9 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
                  let v2 ← tokens.prefix16 s9
                  alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite)
                    (tokens.TokenWrite.Migrate v2)
                else ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite)
              ok (v1, b2)
          if hash_valid
          then
            if now > info.expires_at
            then ok (writes, core.result.Result.Err tokens.TokenError.Expired)
            else
              let v1 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 cache_key
              let v2 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 info.user
              let writes1 ←
                alloc.vec.Vec.push writes (tokens.TokenWrite.CacheInsert
                  {
                    key := v1,
                    user := v2,
                    role := info.role,
                    expires_at := info.expires_at,
                    cached_at := mono
                  })
              let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
              let v3 ← tokens.prefix16 s7
              let writes2 ←
                alloc.vec.Vec.push writes1 (tokens.TokenWrite.LastUsed v3 now)
              ok (writes2, core.result.Result.Ok (info.user, info.role))
          else ok (writes, core.result.Result.Err tokens.TokenError.NotFound)
    | some cached =>
      let i ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_sub mono cached.cached_at)
      if i < store.cache_ttl
      then
        if now > cached.expires_at
        then
          ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, core.result.Result.Err
            tokens.TokenError.Expired)
        else
          let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
          let v ← tokens.prefix16 s2
          let writes ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite)
              (tokens.TokenWrite.LastUsed v now)
          ok (writes, core.result.Result.Ok (cached.user, cached.role))
      else
        let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.files
        let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
        let v ← tokens.prefix16 s3
        let s4 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref v
        let o1 ← tokens.find_file s2 s4
        match o1 with
        | none =>
          ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, core.result.Result.Err
            tokens.TokenError.NotFound)
        | some f =>
          let tf ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
              tokens.TokenFile) store.files f
          match tf.info with
          | none =>
            ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, core.result.Result.Err
              tokens.TokenError.Storage)
          | some i1 =>
            let info ← tokens.TokenInfo.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone i1
            let s5 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref info.token_hash
            let s6 ←
              lift (Array.to_slice
                (Array.make 7#usize [
                  36#u8, 97#u8, 114#u8, 103#u8, 111#u8, 110#u8, 50#u8
                  ]))
            let b1 ← tokens.starts_with s5 s6
            let (writes, hash_valid) ←
              if b1
              then
                do
                let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref info.token_hash
                let hash_valid1 ← oracle.Crypto.argon2_verify crypto token s7
                ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, hash_valid1)
              else
                do
                let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref info.token_hash
                let s8 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
                let b2 ← oracle.bytes_eq s7 s8
                let v1 ←
                  if b2
                  then
                    do
                    let s9 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
                    let v2 ← tokens.prefix16 s9
                    alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite)
                      (tokens.TokenWrite.Migrate v2)
                  else ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite)
                ok (v1, b2)
            if hash_valid
            then
              if now > info.expires_at
              then
                ok (writes, core.result.Result.Err tokens.TokenError.Expired)
              else
                let v1 ←
                  alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 cache_key
                let v2 ←
                  alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 info.user
                let writes1 ←
                  alloc.vec.Vec.push writes (tokens.TokenWrite.CacheInsert
                    {
                      key := v1,
                      user := v2,
                      role := info.role,
                      expires_at := info.expires_at,
                      cached_at := mono
                    })
                let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cache_key
                let v3 ← tokens.prefix16 s7
                let writes2 ←
                  alloc.vec.Vec.push writes1 (tokens.TokenWrite.LastUsed v3
                    now)
                ok (writes2, core.result.Result.Ok (info.user, info.role))
            else ok (writes, core.result.Result.Err tokens.TokenError.NotFound)
  else
    ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new tokens.TokenWrite, core.result.Result.Err
      tokens.TokenError.InvalidFormat)

  rfl

theorem token_accepted_only_unexpired (store : tokens.TokenStore) (cr : oracle.Crypto)
    (t : Slice U8) (now mono : U64) (ws : alloc.vec.Vec tokens.TokenWrite) (u : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (r : Role)
    (h : tokens.verify_token store cr t now mono = ok (ws, .Ok (u, r))) :
    lit "nra_" <+: nats t.val ∧
      ((∃ c ∈ store.cache.val, c.user = u ∧ c.role = r ∧ now.val ≤ c.expires_at.val) ∨
       (∃ f ∈ store.files.val, ∃ i, f.info = some i ∧ i.user = u ∧ i.role = r ∧
         now.val ≤ i.expires_at.val)) := by
  unfold tokens.verify_token at h
  dsimp only at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals try casesm* _ × Bool
  all_goals try simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at h
  all_goals try i5h_invert h
  all_goals
    have hstarts : tokens.starts_with t tokens.TOKEN_PREFIX = ok true := by
      simp_all only
    have hprefix := (starts_with_sound t tokens.TOKEN_PREFIX hstarts).map (fun byte => byte.val)
    change nats tokens.TOKEN_PREFIX.val <+: nats t.val at hprefix
    rw [token_prefix_nats] at hprefix
    refine ⟨hprefix, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    simp_all only [tokens.TokenInfo.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone.ok_eq, ok.injEq]
    first
    | have hmem := vec_index_mem store.files _ _ (by assumption)
      right
      refine ⟨_, hmem, _, by assumption, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      all_goals first | assumption | rfl | scalar_tac
    | have hmem := find_cached_mem (alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.cache) _ _ (by assumption)
      simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref] at hmem
      left
      refine ⟨_, hmem, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      all_goals first | assumption | rfl | scalar_tac

end nora_kernel.Solution
